profile_text.body:
DXC Technology Co is a public company headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, with SEC CIK number 0001688568 and ticker DXC. It is also listed under the alias DXC TECHNOLOGY CO. The company's website is dexus.com.

The website content describes Dexus, an Australasian infrastructure and real estate funds and assets business. It says Dexus has four decades of expertise in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and a multi-billion dollar portfolio. The site mentions that Atlassian Central in Sydney has reached more than 180 metres as the world's tallest hybrid timber tower, and that a redundant Brisbane office became 1,180 student beds through adaptive reuse. Dexus is identified on the site as ASX: DXS.

The company has no AI products or MCP servers. It is associated with 152 legal exposure matters in Virginia. No specific cases are listed.
